entries.name: Beacon of Heroes
entries.description: Utility Fixture. Adds an Adventure Agent, increases Glide, increases Plasmium drops, and has unique spotlight effects.
tiers: Beacon of Heroes, Tier 1 - Permanent access to an agency adventure, has 4 unique spotlights, increases Glide to 105, and provides an additional 5% chance for Plasmium drops.
Beacon of Heroes, Tier 2 - Permanent access to an agency adventure, increases Glide to 110, and provides an additional 10% chance for Plasmium drops.
Beacon of Heroes, Tier 3 - Permanent access to an agency adventure, increases Glide to 120, and provides an additional 15% chance for Plasmium drops.

entries.name: Effigy of Echoing Strikes
entries.description: Ultimate Fixture. Grants a small chance to deal additional damage upon striking an enemy to all members who have selected this as their primary Club.
tiers: Effigy of Echoing Strikes, Tier 1 - Grants a 0.5% chance to deal additional damage upon striking an enemy.
Effigy of Echoing Strikes, Tier 2 - Grants a 0.75% chance to deal additional damage upon striking an enemy.
Effigy of Echoing Strikes, Tier 3 - Grants a 1% chance to deal additional damage upon striking an enemy.

entries.name: Effigy of Flowing Elixirs
entries.description: Ultimate Fixture. Grants a chance to replenish all Flask Charges to all members who have selected this as their primary Club.
tiers: Effigy of Flowing Elixirs, Tier 1 - Grants a 1% chance to replenish all Flask Charges.
Effigy of Flowing Elixirs, Tier 2 - Grants a 2% chance to replenish all Flask Charges.
Effigy of Flowing Elixirs, Tier 3 - Grants a 3% chance to replenish all Flask Charges.

entries.name: Effigy of Frugality
entries.description: Ultimate Fixture. Reduces the upkeep cost of all other fixtures placed in the same Club World.
tiers: Effigy of Frugality, Tier 1 - Reduces the rent cost of all other fixtures placed in this Club World by 10%.
Effigy of Frugality, Tier 2 - Reduces the rent cost of all other fixtures placed in this Club World by 20%.
Effigy of Frugality, Tier 3 - Reduces the rent cost of all other fixtures placed in this Club World by 30%.

entries.name: Effigy of Potent Opulence
entries.description: Ultimate Fixture. Grants a chance to find additional gems and reduces the cost to upgrade gems to all members who have selected this as their primary Club.
tiers: Effigy of Potent Opulence, Tier 1 - Grants a 5% reduction in gem upgrade cost and a small chance to drop prime world gem boxes in any world.
Effigy of Potent Opulence, Tier 2 - Grants a 10% reduction in gem upgrade cost and a 2x greater chance to drop prime world gem boxes in any world.
Effigy of Potent Opulence, Tier 3 - Grants a 20% reduction in gem upgrade cost and a 4x greater chance to drop prime world gem boxes in any world.

entries.name: Font of Knowledge
entries.description: Utility Fixture. Grants a bonus to Experience earned and a chance to gain additional bonus Experience to all members who have selected this as their primary Club.
tiers: Font of Knowledge, Tier 1 - Grants a 10% bonus to Experience earned and a 100% increase to bonus Experience.
Font of Knowledge, Tier 2 - Grants a 20% bonus to Experience earned and a 200% increase to bonus Experience.
Font of Knowledge, Tier 3 - Grants a 30% bonus to Experience earned and a 300% increase to bonus Experience.

entries.name: Hoard of Prosperity
entries.description: Utility Fixture. Grants a bonus to Magic Find and to finding Adventure Boxes, and Pearls of Wisdom if this is selected as your primary Club.
tiers: Hoard of Prosperity, Tier 1 - Grants +100 to Magic Find and a small chance to loot bonus Adventure Boxes, and Pearls of Wisdom.
Hoard of Prosperity, Tier 2 - Grants +150 to Magic Find and a 2x greater chance to loot bonus Adventure Boxes, and Pearls of Wisdom.
Hoard of Prosperity, Tier 3 - Grants +200 to Magic Find and a 4x greater chance to loot bonus Adventure Boxes, and Pearls of Wisdom.

entries.name: Mount Menagerie
entries.description: Utility Fixture. Grants a bonus to Jump and to finding Talismans if this is selected as your primary Club. Tether your mount to the fixture's leash block to show it off!
tiers: Mount Menagerie, Tier 1 - Contains 1 leash block and grants +2 Jump along with a small additional chance to drop Corgi, Meownt, Shmeep, and Centaur Talismans.
Mount Menagerie, Tier 2 - Contains 3 leash blocks and grants +3 Jump along with a 2x higher chance to drop all previous Talismans along with Llama, Rat, and Panda Talismans.
Mount Menagerie, Tier 3 - Contains 5 leash blocks and grants +5 Jump along with a 4x higher chance to drop all previous Talismans along with Griffon Talismans (removes the Skylands Only restriction).

entries.name: Rally of Heroes
entries.description: Key Fixture. Meet an assortment of picturesque Club Heroes and accept adventures to further your Club's growth.
tiers: Rally of Heroes, Tier 1 - 3 Hero Rally Points are available.
Rally of Heroes, Tier 2 - 4 Hero Rally Points are available.
Rally of Heroes, Tier 3 - 5 Hero Rally Points are available.

entries.name: Repose of Heroes
entries.description: Utility Fixture. Attracts a greater variety of Heroes to your Rally of Heroes Fixture. Some Heroes will only appear if this fixture is present in your Club World.
tiers: Repose of Heroes, Tier 1 - Allows for 2 additional Heroes and a slight increase in Adventure variety.
Repose of Heroes, Tier 2 - Allows for 4 additional Heroes and a greater increase in Adventure variety.
Repose of Heroes, Tier 3 - Allows for 6 additional Heroes and the greatest increase in Adventure variety.

entries.name: Scenic Belltower
entries.description: Utility Fixture. Reduces upkeep costs for all Utility Fixtures placed in the same Club World.
tiers: Scenic Belltower, Tier 1 - Reduces rent costs for all Utility Fixtures by 15%.
Scenic Belltower, Tier 2 - Reduces rent costs for all Utility Fixtures by 20%.
Scenic Belltower, Tier 3 - Reduces rent costs for all Utility Fixtures by 25%.

entries.name: Shrine of Efficiency
entries.description: Combat Fixture. Reduces upkeep costs for all Combat Fixtures placed in the same Club World.
tiers: Shrine of Efficiency, Tier 1 - Reduces rent costs for all Combat Fixtures by 15%.
Shrine of Efficiency, Tier 2 - Reduces rent costs for all Combat Fixtures by 20%.
Shrine of Efficiency, Tier 3 - Reduces rent costs for all Combat Fixtures by 25%.

entries.name: Shrine of Ferocity
entries.description: Combat Fixture. Grants a bonus to Physical Damage and Magic Damage to all members who have selected this as their primary Club.
tiers: Shrine of Ferocity, Tier 1 - Grants a 5% bonus to Physical Damage and Magical Damage.
Shrine of Ferocity, Tier 2 - Grants a 10% bonus to Physical Damage and Magical Damage.
Shrine of Ferocity, Tier 3 - Grants a 15% bonus to Physical Damage and Magical Damage.

entries.name: Shrine of Rejuvenation
entries.description: Combat Fixture. Grants a bonus to Health Regeneration and Energy Regeneration to all members who have selected this as their primary Club.
tiers: Shrine of Rejuvenation, Tier 1 - Grants a 50% bonus to Health Regeneration and +1 Energy Regeneration.
Shrine of Rejuvenation, Tier 2 - Grants a 100% bonus to Health Regeneration and +2 Energy Regeneration.
Shrine of Rejuvenation, Tier 3 - Grants a 200% bonus to Health Regeneration and +3 Energy Regeneration.

entries.name: Shrine of Resilience
entries.description: Combat Fixture. Grants a damage reduction effect to all members who have selected this as their primary Club.
tiers: Shrine of Resilience, Tier 1 - Grants 2.5% damage reduction.
Shrine of Resilience, Tier 2 - Grants 5% damage reduction.
Shrine of Resilience, Tier 3 - Grants 10% damage reduction.

entries.name: Shrine of Skill
entries.description: Combat Fixture. Grants a bonus to Critical Hit chance and Critical Damage dealt to all members who have selected this as their primary Club.
tiers: Shrine of Skill, Tier 1 - Grants an additional 2% critical hit and 25% Critical Damage.
Shrine of Skill, Tier 2 - Grants an additional 5% Critical Hit and 50% Critical Damage.
Shrine of Skill, Tier 3 - Grants an additional 10% Critical Hit and 100% Critical Damage.

entries.name: Shrine of Vitality
entries.description: Combat Fixture. Grants a bonus to Maximum Health to all members who have selected this as their primary Club.
tiers: Shrine of Vitality, Tier 1 - Grants a 25% bonus to Maximum Health.
Shrine of Vitality, Tier 2 - Grants a 50% bonus to Maximum Health.
Shrine of Vitality, Tier 3 - Grants a 100% bonus to Maximum Health.

entries.name: Travelling Club Merchant
entries.description: Utility Fixture. Places fixture that houses a Club Merchant selling a variety of wares. Higher tier fixture Merchants have new and unique goods for sale!
tiers: Travelling Club Merchant, Tier 1 - Grants 100 Clubits a day from the Market Daily Bonus block, as well as a Merchant who sells unique items.
Travelling Club Merchant, Tier 2 - Grants 200 Clubits a day from the Market Daily Bonus block, as well as a Merchant who sells even more unique items.
Travelling Club Merchant, Tier 3 - Grants 300 Clubits a day from the Market Daily Bonus block, as well as a Merchant who sells the most unique items.

entries.name: Trovian Clubit Union
entries.description: Key Fixture. Deposit your extra Clubits here to contribute to Club upgrades and improvements.
tiers: Trovian Clubit Union, Tier 1 - Allows for a maximum of 3000 Clubits to be contributed to the Club.
Trovian Clubit Union, Tier 2 - Allows for a maximum of 9000 Clubits to be contributed to the Club.
Trovian Clubit Union, Tier 3 - Allows for an uncapped amount of Clubits to be contributed to the Club.
